mapper.insert: INSERT INTO token (chain_id, address, symbol, decimals, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{chainId}, #{address}, #{symbol}, #{decimals}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (chain_id, address) DO UPDATE SET symbol = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.symbol, token.symbol), decimals = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.decimals, token.decimals), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = NOW()
